citation: Sri Lanka Facts. Census Atlas 2024 private preview (v2026.11.10-preview.2).

indicator.definition: Number of occupied housing units enumerated by the Census of Population and Housing. A housing unit is a separate unit with independent walls; one housing unit may contain more than one household. This is not the same as the number of households.
indicator.name: Occupied housing units
